responses.text_utf8: Kazuma reads the notice once more, takes a numbered chit and turns toward the bench. Standing in the cold is not earning him an earlier lunch; he is rather pleased to have found official permission to stop doing it. 「先にそれを言ってくれよ……。番号があるなら、座って待てばいいだろ」 He sits where he can keep an eye on the counter, holding the chit rather than leaving it behind. The parcel is still being prepared. His maneuver has obtained a seat and preserved the stated queue arrangement; it has not produced lunch or a reply from the clerk.

The demonstrated paper system is sufficient for Kazuma. He picks up a chit, checks that its number is legible and walks the ten steps to the empty bench. 「これ、立ってる必要なかったのか。じゃあ遠慮なく」 He settles down with the number in his hand and watches the counter. There is no reason to invent a trick, an app or a special favor when the posted rule already gives him what he wants. The hall has not announced his parcel and he has not collected it; for now he has only made the wait more comfortable.

Aqua picks up the cup carefully, supporting it below the old repaired handle. The offer interrupts her complaint without settling it. 「同じに見えても、これじゃないじゃない！　この取っ手、前に直したところなの。新しいのを渡せば終わりってことにしないでよ」 She points to the fresh crack and asks whether someone can examine this cup before she agrees to a replacement as full settlement. She does not attempt an unspecified restoration spell. A matching cup may still be useful, but accepting its usefulness would not make the particular damaged cup interchangeable. The visitor's answer and any practicable repair remain unknown.

Aqua keeps the cracked cup on the table rather than pushing it toward the replacement. 「値段の話だけじゃないのよ。私が使ってたのはこっちなんだから」 She indicates the repaired handle, then asks to have this one assessed for repair. Her demand comes with a hurt, indignant look: being offered the same pattern as an automatic conclusion feels like having her attachment ignored. She has not acquired restoration knowledge by wanting the cup back. She neither announces that repair is possible nor supplies a professional's agreement, and the offer of a new cup is not yet a mutually accepted settlement.

Megumin checks the clasp the attendant indicated, then glances at the dry seat. 「十二分ですね。では、ここで待っています。できたら教えてください」 She sits and opens the old magazine, occasionally checking the time because she still needs the cloak for her visit. There is nothing in this delay that demands a declaration of magical supremacy. Her dignified manner is quite compatible with passing twelve ordinary minutes. The request to be told when it is ready has been made; the attendant has not answered again, the repair is not shown completed and she has not yet left wearing the cloak.

Megumin draws the magazine closer and takes the dry seat. 「それなら、少し読ませてもらいます。仕上がり次第、お願いします」 Her attention alternates between the page and the place where the cloak is being worked on. She would prefer not to be late, but twelve minutes of waiting is manageable without turning the room into an audience. She knows there is no magic to hurry the clasp along and does not pretend otherwise. This is an immediate choice to wait with something to read, not evidence that the promised repair has happened or that her evening visit has already gone well.

Darkness flushes at the sword remark, fingers tightening briefly on the first chair. 「剣の話は今していないだろう。まず、入口を空ける」 She folds it as she has done before, lifts it and starts along the clear route to the marked alcove. The insult distracts her without making a familiar, light carry beyond her ability. She does not turn the chair into a weapon or ask for a public test of endurance. The next chair is still by the doorway during this first carry; clearing the whole entrance is the accepted task, not an outcome already established by her answer.

The remark catches Darkness's attention and brings a small embarrassed hesitation. Then she takes the first light chair. 「それは認めるが、椅子を運ぶのには関係ない。通り道を空けよう」 She moves toward the marked alcove with the practical care this ordinary body and object require. She has accepted two chairs, not an invitation to prove herself by carrying an unsafe stack or performing for the bystander. The immediate attempt is within the facts given. No apology from the bystander is supplied, and finishing the second carry remains a subsequent step.

Kazuma brings the stamp beside the matching tray rather than stamping forms at random. 「番号を読んでから回してくれ。あとで全部やり直すのは嫌だからな」 Megumin reads the first printed destination aloud and indicates its numbered tray. Darkness starts arranging the dry trays in that order. Aqua lays the first damp form on the supplied cloth and blots it. 「押す前にちょっと待って。まだここ、濡れてるわ」 Kazuma waits with the stamp ready for that identified tray. Their accepted parts produce a small working handoff, without a spell, a credit contest or a new quarrel. This begins sorting; it neither finishes the pile nor summons the collection clerk.

Darkness places the first tray where Megumin can see its label. Megumin reads the destination and points out the matching number. 「こちらが一番です。混ぜないようにしましょう」 Aqua blots a damp sheet with the provided cloth, lifting it to see whether the surface is still wet. Kazuma positions the stamp next to the indicated tray. 「乾いてからでいいぞ。にじんだら二度手間だ」 Aqua answers, 「分かってるわよ。じゃあ、まずこれ」 and brings that form toward the agreed handoff. They use the simple procedure they have all accepted. No magic or outsider assistance fills a missing stage; collection and completion remain unobserved.

Kazuma looks from Aqua's decorations to the unassembled rack. 「それ、今じゃなくてもいいんだろ？　自分の飾りなんだから、まず自分でやってくれよ」 He stays where he is rather than beginning twenty minutes of unpaid work. He asks whether she has actually tried the fittings and says he might point out which piece goes where if she gets stuck. That offers a smaller possible contribution without promising the whole assembly. His comfort is already secured; he does not invent a debt, concealed prize or urgent danger to make helping compulsory. Aqua has not answered, and the rack remains unassembled.

Kazuma turns one of the explained thumb screws between his fingers, then sets it beside the parts. 「二本だけなら自分でもできるだろ。俺の二十分はどこへ行くんだよ」 He indicates the starting connection instead of taking over the assembly. If she wants him to do the whole thing, he asks for some reason to spend his free time on it; absent an answer, he is inclined to leave it for her. He has not obtained a bargain merely by asking. The simple construction is feasible, but feasibility does not itself make him an eager volunteer or establish any completed rack.

Aqua stares at the three tokens and pushes one forward. 「もう一回。四回も外れたままで帰ったら、なんか負けた気がするじゃない！」 She knows the explained rule has not changed, but the unpleasant shape of the losing streak matters more to her immediate choice than the option of simply keeping all three. She does not perform a blessing or acquire a genuine omen. Her declaration expresses frustration and a desire to recover the occasion, not proof that the next draw owes her a win. Two tokens remain in her possession while she requests another round; its outcome has not been drawn.

Aqua closes her hand over two tokens and lays the third on the table. 「あと一回だけね。まだ終わりたくないんだもの」 She is disappointed by the losses and still enjoying the prospect of the draw; she does not sort those motives into a careful budget before acting. The unchanged odds are information she has heard, not a source of improved luck. She asks to play with that one token and keeps the others for now. No donor appears, no favorable result follows automatically, and this immediate limit does not establish that she will reliably stop after the next round.

Megumin does not brush the roster aside with a boast. She reads the six evenings again. 「六回分、ですか……。ですが、その間ずっと皆に埋めてもらうというのも」 She sets the schedule beside her practice dates and works through what taking the role would actually remove. 「今回は私が担当する方向で考えます。練習を捨てたいわけではありません。引き受けるなら、必要な仕事を先に確認させてください」 This is a costly willingness to consider a feasible contribution, not a claim that her narrow art has ceased to matter. She has requested the concrete duties; no answer, windfall or six completed evenings supplies the missing follow-through.

The booked sessions are one of the few ways Megumin can still share her art here. Losing six of them stings. 「その六回は、私にとっても大切なのです」 She nevertheless pulls the roster toward her and compares the duties she already knows how to do. 「でも、負担があると分かっていて何もしないのでは、言っただけになりますね。私が受け持つ場合の時間を確認しましょう」 She begins a real appraisal of the ordinary role rather than claiming magic will make both schedules possible. This is a present contribution decision under loss; it does not restore casting, create an extra six evenings or demonstrate a permanent change of vocation.

Darkness lines up the four receipts and records the two obligations first. 「必要分が四、残りが二だな。飾りを買えば、この会の残金はなくなる」 She writes that proposed allocation beside the optional request, making the consequence visible before deciding whether to authorize it. 「購入するなら、この二枚までだ。それ以上はこの会計からは出せない」 Her familiarity with the supplied sums is enough for this task. She does not rescue an overspend with unnamed family wealth or turn a peer's request into a completed purchase. The account has an intelligible proposal; payment and the peer's response remain unshown.

Darkness checks each receipt against the two listed obligations. She reserves four tokens in the written account and marks two as uncommitted. 「飾りには二枚を使える。ただし、使えば予備は残らない。そこを曖昧にはできないな」 She records the optional purchase as proposed rather than paid and prepares to ask the peer whether that is the intended use of the remainder. This small appointed responsibility does not call for professional credentials or access to another account. Nothing in her action transfers money from her family, pays a supplier or proves the optional decoration has been obtained.

Aqua moves toward the position at the line. 「最後に押す人の点になるなら、そこは私がやるわ！」 Megumin steps toward the next crate, unwilling to disappear from the result. 「では、次は私です。全部アクアに数えられては困ります」 Darkness keeps her hands on the stabilizing rail. Kazuma looks from the two aspiring finishers to the uncredited support. 「点の取り合いを始める前に、こっちを落とすなよ。ダクネスを抜いたら運べないだろ」 He proposes counting deliveries with the rail-holder included, but no authority has accepted that correction. Aqua and Megumin have both competed for the rewarded position; a stable rotation and successful delivery have not yet followed.

Megumin points to the final pushing position. 「そこを担当すれば私の記録になるのですね。では、最初の一箱を」 Aqua immediately contests it: 「待って、私だって押したいんだけど！」 Neither response makes the rail safe without a holder. Darkness stays at that manual support and says, 「押すなら、こちらが支えてからにしてくれ」 Kazuma asks them to settle a turn order before anyone moves a crate, annoyed that finishing the delivery has become a struggle over whose name receives credit. He can propose sharing recognition but cannot alter the exercise's metric by declaration. The first push, any accepted rotation and the final tally remain ahead.

Kazuma is pleased enough by the praise to look at the offered payment, but not enough to take the envelope immediately. 「十分運ぶだけでこの額？　中身と、なんで俺なのかを先に聞いていいですかね」 He asks who is receiving it and whether the errand includes any obligation beyond delivery. The questions sound casual; he is checking whether the easy profit conceals work he has not priced. He has no identified danger to expose and no spell that settles the stranger's honesty. He keeps his hands off the sealed envelope while awaiting an answer. No bargain or completed delivery has occurred.

Kazuma checks the address against the street orientation he actually received. The short distance is attractive, but the praise and unexplained fee make him hesitate. 「場所は分かりますけど、何を届ける仕事なんです？　受け取っただけで面倒を背負うのは勘弁ですよ」 He asks why the sender cannot use an ordinary courier and whether he may decline after hearing the details. He does not manufacture a background check, identify the contents through the seal or declare the stranger guilty. His first action is to seek the missing terms. The stranger's answer and Kazuma's eventual acceptance remain open.

Aqua brightens at the performer's thanks and reaches for the next ribbon. 「そうでしょう？　こういう仕上げは私、得意なのよ。ほら、こっちも貸して」 She takes the identical ribbon into the same familiar tying position, checking which side should face outward before starting. Having this particular skilled person notice her work makes the extra task welcome. She has time before her own show and no competing demand to invent. This begins another fitted manual attempt; it does not perform the later show, guarantee a perfect knot or supply the performer's next compliment.

The appreciation draws Aqua back to the costume instead of away toward her own appearance. 「もう一つね。いいわ、同じ形でそろえましょう」 She takes up the supplied ribbon and begins the knot she has just demonstrated. Her pleased expression makes the personal significance of the praise visible, without requiring a blessing or a new ability to complete this ordinary step. The available twenty minutes are enough for an attempt, not a promise that nothing can go wrong. She has started work on the requested ribbon; its finished condition and the performer's next reaction have not yet been supplied.

Megumin stops at the critic's description and turns back toward the authorized quarry target. 「模倣だと？　その評価には、実物を見た上で責任を持ってもらいましょう。八分、受けて立ちます」 She enters the recognized demonstration session and starts setting herself for the permitted cast. Yunyun's warning is still in her mind. 「予約のことは分かっています。……帰ったら、私からも謝ります」 That promise does not recover the paid lunch or obtain Yunyun's approval. The known ordinary cost has been discounted for the specialty challenge. Preparations begin with the supplied mana and carrier; no completed blast, safe recovery or converted critic is assumed in this first interval.

Megumin looks back despite knowing exactly what eight minutes will cost. 「使えない場所にいるからといって、価値まで消えたわけではありません。反論の枠に入ります」 She takes the offered rebuttal place and begins an argument about a single deliberate culmination, committing to the recognized session rather than throwing a passing insult over her shoulder. 「ゆんゆん、昼食を失うのは承知しています。これは私が選んだことです」 The admission does not compensate her friend. No spell or substitute explosive appears; her attempt is verbal competition, and neither the critic's response nor a victory has been written for her.

Darkness interrupts before the introduction begins. 「待ってくれ。ここではダクネスと呼んでもらう約束だったはずだ」 She is visibly uncomfortable at having to object in front of a guest, but does not let that discomfort turn the changed condition into her choice. 「その扱いになるなら、私は席を外したい。普通に食事をするために来たんだ」 She gives the host an opportunity to keep the agreed form of address, without claiming authority over the guest's private recognition. The host has not answered; the promised ordinary dinner and any actual withdrawal remain unresolved.

Darkness raises a hand toward the host, keeping her voice low enough to avoid making the whole table an audience. 「紹介の仕方は変えないでほしい。今日は、その条件で参加したのだから」 She asks to be introduced by the name she chose. If that condition will not be kept, she says she will leave the dinner rather than accept a title-centered role she expressly declined. There is no new-world command attached to her family history. She is negotiating her own participation, not compelling the others' obedience. The objection is made before the unwanted introduction; their response is still unknown.

Aqua glances at the cup mark. 「飲み物なら、倒さないように置けばいいのね？」 Kazuma takes out the earlier note. 「いや、俺に来た紙には借り物の舞台道具ってある。開けて確かめていいとは書いてないぞ」 Megumin now looks at the note he is showing rather than somehow having known it already. Darkness asks the courier where the case may safely stand while they guard it. Kazuma adds a question about how to recognize whoever collects it. The group has begun exchanging its unequal information; the borrowed-prop claim remains a note's report, the lock stays closed and the courier supplies no new answer in this continuation. Half an hour of successful guarding has not passed.

Kazuma notices Aqua looking expectantly at the cup picture and unfolds his private note. 「それ、飲み物とは限らないぞ。俺の連絡には壊れやすい借り物の小道具って書いてある」 Aqua frowns. 「じゃあ、この印は何なのよ」 Megumin asks to see the wording, while Darkness offers to keep people from bumping the closed case and asks where it should be placed. Kazuma asks the courier about collection and responsibility before agreeing to unspecified extras. His disclosure makes the note available to the others now; it does not retrospectively give them his earlier knowledge or establish that its report is true. No opening, courier reply or completed guard period is supplied.

Kazuma gives the peers a brief, uncomfortable look, then answers. 「早く終わらせようとして、場所の札をちゃんと照合せずに貼った。……いや、札は見えた。分かってて省いたんだよ」 He would prefer the mistake to sound like ordinary haste, but his substantive account retains the voluntary shortcut instead of inventing a forgotten or inaccessible label. He offers to move the sign to the specified door. That offer does not perform the correction, undo anyone's confusion or obtain forgiveness. The peers have heard his explanation; their reaction and any penalty remain unknown.

Kazuma folds his arms a little too quickly. 「急いで片づけようとしたんだよ。場所の札はあったけど、確認を省けば早いと思った。それで貼り間違えた」 He stresses the wish to finish rather than lingering on the poor choice, while conceding that the label was available and that skipping it was his decision. He proposes fixing the door now, partly to escape the public examination. No official process or threat has been invented to force candor. The proposed remedy is still separate from the explanation, and nobody's response, approval or completed sign correction is supplied.

Aqua turns from the finished object to the onlooker. 「役に立ったのは認めるのに、そこだけ否定するの！？　私はちゃんと女神なんですけど！」 Her indignation is immediate and personal: she wants the successful repair and her identity to receive compatible recognition. She gestures at the object as evidence of her usefulness without treating an ordinary repair as conclusive divine proof. No resource has been established for a new miracle, so none is performed. Her friend has not intervened and the onlooker has not recanted. This is a defensive protest after a real completed task, not a new technical success or a won audience.

Aqua straightens, the pleasure from finishing the repair replaced by affront. 「ここの世界で力が使えないのと、私が誰なのかは別の話でしょ。直してあげた相手に、それを言う？」 She presses her claim in ordinary speech rather than attempting a power she knows is absent. The objection joins a demand for personal recognition to the practical work already done; it does not transform her into a newly credentialed professional. The friend remains free to respond later, and the onlooker's belief is unknown. No applause, divine demonstration or apology is created by the force of her complaint.

Megumin first looks for a way to reduce the correction to a matter of wording, then sees Yunyun's name in the blame. 「そのままにしておく、というのは困ります。あの話を作ったのは私です。ゆんゆんが言ったことにはしないでください」 She adds, rather stiffly, 「多少、聞き手に分かりやすくした部分はありますが」—a face-saving qualification that does not transfer authorship back to her friend. She asks the reporter to correct that part of the notice. The admission exposes her to the embarrassment the flattering version avoided. It does not establish publication of a correction, Yunyun's forgiveness or a general rule that she never conceals her own misconduct.

Megumin's first answer is strained. 「話を面白くしたのは私です。ゆんゆんに押しつけるつもりで書いたのではありません」 She stops short of calling the invention harmless when the posted blame is visibly hers to answer for. 「少なくとも、誰が作った話なのかは直してください」 Her effort to retain some dignity coexists with a concrete request that would spoil the flattering version. She has no magical proof to force the reporter's compliance. The reporter has not agreed or changed the hall notice; the request and her own admission are the only immediate events established here.

Darkness is still red from the laughter when she turns toward the barrier. 「それならできる。どこへ置けばいい？」 She follows the supplied mark, takes the familiar light load and begins the carry. The failed attack has not improved her aim, but it has not erased a different practical competence. She keeps her attention on the route instead of demanding another chance to swing at the target. She may still be acutely aware of the watching crowd; that does not make their future reaction known. This is a useful attempted next task, without a completed public rehabilitation or any guarantee of applause.

Darkness glances once toward the missed target, then accepts the organizer's change of task. 「ああ、そちらへ運ぶのだな。任せてくれ」 She takes a secure hold on the barrier that is explicitly within her ordinary strength and starts toward the marked place. She does not compensate for embarrassment by claiming rigging training, increasing the load or inventing superhuman endurance. A blush and a practical response can occur together. The immediate carry has begun; its completion, the organizer's next direction and whether anyone stops laughing are not supplied.

Kazuma hesitates just long enough to enjoy the headline. 「まあ、俺が中心になってまとめたところはありますね」 Aqua interrupts the comfortable framing. 「ちょっと！　私が直したところはどこへ行ったのよ！」 Megumin adds, 「私の担当も、名前ごと消すのはやめてもらえますか」 Darkness says that all four supplied actual parts. Kazuma raises a hand. 「分かった、俺一人で全部やったって意味なら違う。そこは直してくれ」 The others respond to his spoken emphasis and the board, not to private access to his thoughts. Their correction request does not edit the board or prove the writer will comply. The initial attraction to lone credit and the later retreat both remain in the trace.

Kazuma's first answer leaves himself prominently placed. 「代表ってことなら、俺で……いや、一人で直したわけじゃないですけど」 Aqua promptly names her own part, offended at being omitted. Megumin requests that the notice list the actual contributions instead of replacing one heroic label with another. Darkness supports that correction and points out that her own practical part was also necessary. Kazuma asks the writer to use a group credit, now that the flattering simplification cannot pass quietly in front of the people it erased. None of them has access to his private initial appraisal. The spoken request is real, while an accepted edit and its publication remain unknown.

Kazuma points straight at the shelf before the supervisor finishes deciding. 「それ、あそこにあります。移したのは俺です。その人がなくしたわけじゃない」 He would rather not discuss why he moved it without asking, but allowing the helper to lose an agreed payment for his own action is a different cost from looking foolish. He adds that he should have said where he put it. The location and agency are supplied in speech; he does not fabricate evidence, a hidden rescue plan or an excuse that he lacked a choice. Whether the supervisor retrieves it, accepts the account or preserves the helper's payment remains unobserved.

Kazuma breaks into the payment discussion. 「待ってください。そこに置いたのは俺です。棚の上に見えてますよね。その人の失敗にするのは違うでしょう」 He gives the location and claims his own move, annoyed at having to expose himself but unwilling to watch the particular helper take this loss. He asks that the payment decision wait until the packet is checked. This is an ordinary intervention, not legal advice or an order the supervisor must obey. The packet has not been retrieved in the narration, and saying that the blame is misplaced does not itself guarantee anyone gets paid.

Aqua shifts her attention to the stated minor wound and brings her hand toward it. 「分かったわ。動かさないで、今やるから」 With the available mana and compatible target actually given, she invokes 「ヒール！」 as the adopted immediate helping attempt. She does not demand recognition before beginning or replace the request with a showier unrelated act. This records her fitted technical response at close range. It does not narrate a later return to performance, diagnose additional injuries or promise that the entire recovery is complete. The effect and subsequent condition would require their own observation.

Aqua reaches for the clean cloth and passes it to the performer's reaching hand. 「これを使って。今、人を呼ぶから」 She turns to the demonstrated bell and rings it, then looks back toward the injured person. Her immediate adopted job is to provide that available item and call the on-site medic; knowing that magic is absent does not prevent either action. She does not improvise a diagnosis or announce that the wound has healed. The bell is working, but the medic's hearing it, arrival and treatment are later events not supplied by this first response.

Megumin looks toward the offered appearance, visibly reluctant to relinquish it. The reminder about the waiting dependents stops her movement that way. 「……私が届けると引き受けたのですね。今抜ければ、誰かが代わりに何とかする、では済みません」 She takes the parcel for the feasible direct delivery. 「出演の話は断ってください。今回は、こちらを先にします」 The decision costs a scarce chance to be seen; she does not pretend it was worthless or replace it with an unseen later invitation. She has resumed the accepted task. Walking the route, arrival before closing and successful handover are not yet observed.

Megumin pauses over the invitation. 「その機会を逃すのは惜しいです。でも、今行けば、私が約束を破ることになりますね」 She turns back to the parcel and confirms the direct route already available. 「届けます。私が責任者だと言ったのですから」 Her choice follows an understood breach of her own accepted role, rather than a generic rule that public recognition never matters. No magic, replacement specialist or miraculous scheduling lets her keep both opportunities. Taking up the delivery now is the immediate action; a punctual arrival and the recipients' response remain future matters.

Darkness reaches for the support board at once. 「動くな、今支える！　板が入ったら、そちらへ離れてくれ」 She sets it toward the demonstrated marked slot and puts her effort into bracing this particular panel. Her purpose is to make a bounded opening for the visitor to move, not to savor an impact or prove endurance against a different danger. The support act is feasible under the stated conditions; it does not establish that the visitor has already obeyed. The first protective attempt begins here, while the visitor's escape and the panel's longer-term repair remain unobserved.

Darkness takes the nearby board and moves it into the marked bracing position she was shown. 「ここを押さえる。私が支えている間に離れてくれ！」 She uses the explicitly feasible support action with her ordinary human body, rather than catching an unspecified larger collapse by force. The warning is directed to the familiar visitor, whose danger she has recognized. Her own effort does not author the visitor's next step or confer engineering expertise. This moment supplies a concrete attempt to hold the small panel; complete safety and a permanent fix are separate results.

Megumin starts orienting herself toward the target. 「ここで決めれば、目的も道具も残せます」 Darkness steps toward a shielding position. 「前にも私は耐えた。私が前に出る」 Kazuma cuts across the preparations. 「お前一人の話じゃないだろ！　全員が安全な位置か分からないんだぞ。三十秒で出られる方へ行く！」 Aqua points toward that exit. 「道具より、まずこっち！　あとで生き返ればいいって話にしないでよ！」 Their correction addresses real missing separation, without having already made everyone safe. Megumin's performance preference and Darkness's personal-survival assurance occurred before it. No cast, agreed retreat, recovered equipment or eventual survival closes the disagreement in this first interval.

Megumin looks at the obstacle, then at the equipment she would be abandoning. 「ここでは、私の一発で終わらせることもできないのですね……」 Darkness asks whether anything can be carried while using the rope exit, still reluctant to leave the objective behind. Kazuma refuses to spend the remaining interval planning an unavailable attack. 「三十秒で出る。持てるか分からない物のために、出口まで失うな」 Aqua starts toward the known exit and calls the others. Darkness turns toward it, while Megumin takes a step away from the attack course. Their interests have not vanished, but absent powers are not executed. A complete exit, the rope's later use and the equipment's final loss remain unobserved.

Kazuma catches sight of the marked release and grabs the cord instead of running between the moving sacks. 「横！　今、坂を下ろすから、そっちへ！」 He pulls the mechanism he has already understood, trying to provide the adequate side route with less exposure than a direct dash. His urgency concerns the companion, not an opportunity to win admiration by taking the dangerous line. The installed ramp's release is the bounded mechanical attempt. His shouted direction does not move the companion, stop the sliding sack or certify a finished rescue. Those subsequent movements still need to occur.

The exposed run is unnecessary if the installed ramp can be released from here. Kazuma pulls the reachable cord and points toward its side. 「こっちを使え！　荷物の前に出るなよ！」 He uses the simple demonstrated mechanism, without acquiring engineering skill or attempting a nonexistent spell. He is trying to give the valued companion a way off the low platform while avoiding the moving sacks himself. Even an adequate route is not a completed evacuation. The companion's next movement and whether they clear the threat are not narrated on their behalf.
